senses.en: all of something

ex.en: I spent the whole morning in the lab.
ex.zh: 我整个上午都在实验室。

ex.en: Protecting a whole river means caring for farms and factories, not only the city section.
ex.zh: 保护整条河意味着要管农场和工厂，而不只是城区那一段。

tip: whole 前面通常有 the 或物主代词：the whole day。

senses.en: an idea or the act of thinking
past form of think

ex.en: That is a thoughtful question.
ex.zh: 那是一个有想法的问题。

ex.en: A single thoughtless comment online can follow a student longer than the mistake that caused it.
ex.zh: 网上一句欠考虑的话，可能比引发它的那个错误跟随学生更久。

tip: thought 也是 think 的过去式和过去分词。

senses.en: to respect or look up to someone
To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive

ex.en: I admire her courage in difficult times.
ex.zh: 我钦佩她在困难时期的勇气。

ex.en: People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.
ex.zh: 人们常因成功运动员的毅力而钦佩他们，但坚持训练同样重要。

col: admire someone for something｜因某事钦佩某人
tip: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

senses.en: a state or requirement
A requirement, or circumstances affecting life or activity
A medical problem affecting someone's health

ex.en: The road is in poor condition.
ex.zh: 这条路状况很差。

ex.en: Improving working conditions can increase employee satisfaction and reduce the number of people leaving their jobs.
ex.zh: 改善工作条件可以提高员工满意度，并减少离职人数。

tip: 表状态通常不可数；表工作、生活环境常用复数。

senses.en: how heavy something is

ex.en: The bag is light in weight.
ex.zh: 这个包重量很轻。

ex.en: The weight of a full schoolbag is a daily load, especially for younger children on a long walk.
ex.zh: 装满的书包的重量是每天的负担，尤其对走远路的年幼孩子。

tip: weight 是名词；weigh 是动词“称重”。

senses.en: to move around, or to become
a chance to do something, or a change of direction

ex.en: Turn left at the bookshop.
ex.zh: 在书店处向左转。

ex.en: Parks can turn a hot street into a place where people are willing to walk.
ex.zh: 公园能把一条炎热的街道变成人们愿意步行的地方。

tip: turn 加形容词表示变化：turn green。开灯用 turn on，不是 open the light。

senses.en: one part or one item

ex.en: May I have a piece of paper?
ex.zh: 我可以要一张纸吗？

ex.en: A piece of false news can travel farther than the correction that follows it.
ex.zh: 一条假消息可以比随后的更正传得更远。

tip: 不可数名词要说数量时常用 a piece of。

senses.en: what a person thinks

ex.en: In my opinion, the second answer is better.
ex.zh: 在我看来，第二个答案更好。

ex.en: Public opinion changes when people see the flooded street, not only the plan.
ex.zh: 当人们看到积水的街道而不只是方案时，舆论会改变。

tip: opinion 是可数名词。

senses.en: allowed by law
Allowed by the law

ex.en: Is this action legal?
ex.zh: 这个行为合法吗？

ex.en: Access to affordable legal services is essential for ensuring that disadvantaged citizens can defend their rights.
ex.zh: 让人们获得负担得起的法律服务，对保障弱势公民维护自身权利至关重要。

tip: legal可指“法律相关的”，不一定指“合法的”。

senses.en: a person who leads

ex.en: The team leader explained the plan.
ex.zh: 队长解释了计划。

ex.en: A good leader asks who will be harmed before a new road is approved.
ex.zh: 好的领导者在批准新路之前会问谁将受到伤害。

tip: leader 是人；leadership 是领导能力。

senses.en: most important

ex.en: The main entrance is on the left.
ex.zh: 正门在左边。

ex.en: The main reason for late arrivals is the bus, not a lack of interest in the first lesson.
ex.zh: 迟到的主要原因是公交，不是对第一节课缺乏兴趣。

tip: main 没有比较级。mainly 是副词“主要地”。

senses.en: more than two but not many

ex.en: Several students stayed to tidy the lab.
ex.zh: 几个学生留下来收拾实验室。

ex.en: Several small parks can serve a neighbourhood better than one large park that is hard to reach.
ex.zh: 几个小公园服务一个社区，可能好过一座很难到达的大公园。

tip: several 后接可数名词复数。

senses.en: up to a particular time
up to the time when

ex.en: The shop is open until nine.
ex.zh: 商店营业到九点。

ex.en: A library that stays open until the last bus can serve students who cannot study at home.
ex.zh: 开到末班车的图书馆，可以服务那些无法在家学习的学生。

tip: until 可作介词或连词。not...until 表示直到……才。

senses.en: every one separately

ex.en: Each student has a different seat number.
ex.zh: 每个学生的座位号都不一样。

ex.en: Each small shop that closes on a high street takes away a place where neighbours used to talk.
ex.zh: 商业街上每关掉一家小店，就少了一个邻居们曾经聊天的地方。

tip: each of 加复数名词时，谓语常用单数。

senses.en: an emotion or a physical sense

ex.en: I had a feeling that the answer was wrong.
ex.zh: 我有一种感觉，这个答案是错的。

ex.en: A feeling of safety on the walk home depends on lights, not only on a low crime number.
ex.zh: 回家路上的安全感取决于灯光，而不只是一个很低的犯罪数字。

tip: feeling 是可数名词。

senses.en: more than usual

ex.en: I need extra time to check the answers.
ex.zh: 我需要额外的时间检查答案。

ex.en: Extra lanes do not cut traffic if they only invite more cars.
ex.zh: 如果额外的车道只是招来更多汽车，它们并不能减少交通。

tip: extra 可作形容词或名词。

senses.en: in opposition to, or touching

ex.en: Our team will play against Class Three.
ex.zh: 我们队将和三班比赛。

ex.en: Laws against litter only work when bins are near and people see that the rules apply to everyone.
ex.zh: 禁止乱扔垃圾的法律，只有在附近有垃圾桶、而且人人都受约束时才有效。

tip: against 是介词，后面接名词、代词或 doing。

senses.en: a very short time

ex.en: Wait a moment, please.
ex.zh: 请稍等。

ex.en: The moment a rumour is shared, it is harder to replace it with a correction.
ex.zh: 谣言一经转发，就更难用更正来替换它。

tip: the moment 可引导时间从句，相当于 as soon as。

senses.en: strength, control, or electricity
to supply energy to a machine

ex.en: The storm cut the power for two hours.
ex.zh: 暴风雨导致停电两小时。

ex.en: The power to change a bus route should sit with people who actually ride it, not only with planners.
ex.zh: 更改公交线路的权力，应该掌握在真正乘坐它的人手里，而不只是规划者。

tip: power 表示电力时不可数。作动词是“驱动”或“供电”。

senses.en: of the west

ex.en: We compared a western folk story with a Chinese one.
ex.zh: 我们把一个西方民间故事和中国故事做了比较。

ex.en: Western visitors may admire an old street and still miss the rents that local families pay.
ex.zh: 西方游客可能欣赏一条老街，却仍然看不到本地家庭支付的房租。

tip: western 是形容词，通常不大写，除非是专名的一部分。

senses.en: a group effort for change, or the act of moving

ex.en: The movement to save the river started at school.
ex.zh: 拯救这条河的运动从学校开始。

ex.en: Free movement to a clinic matters when the only road floods.
ex.zh: 当唯一的路积水时，能自由前往诊所就很重要。

tip: movement 可指社会运动，也可指动作。

senses.en: a person with special skill
Having or showing great knowledge or skill.

ex.en: Ask an expert for advice.
ex.zh: 向专家征求建议。

ex.en: Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.
ex.zh: 学校在将新技术引入课堂以辅助学生学习之前，应征求专家意见。

col: an expert on｜某方面的专家
tip: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

senses.en: one more, or a different one

ex.en: May I ask another question?
ex.zh: 我可以再问一个问题吗？

ex.en: Another heatwave will test whether the city's new shelters are more than a promise on paper.
ex.zh: 又一轮热浪将检验这座城市的新避暑点是否不只是纸上的承诺。

tip: another 后接单数名词；“另外两个”可以说 another two days。

senses.en: a structure with a roof and walls

ex.en: The new building has a lift.
ex.zh: 新楼有电梯。

ex.en: An empty building in the town centre is a wasted chance to house a clinic or a library.
ex.zh: 镇中心的空楼是浪费，本可以用来做诊所或图书馆。

tip: building 是名词；build 是动词，过去式 built。

senses.en: possibly

ex.en: Perhaps we can finish before lunch.
ex.zh: 也许我们能在午饭前做完。

ex.en: Perhaps a later school start would help, but only if the buses change too.
ex.zh: 也许推迟上学时间会有帮助，但只有公交也改才行。

tip: perhaps 比 maybe 稍正式，意思接近。

senses.en: knowledge from careful study and experiment

ex.en: Science class is in the lab today.
ex.zh: 今天的科学课在实验室。

ex.en: Science can measure dirty air, but a city still has to decide what to do about it.
ex.zh: 科学可以测量脏空气，但城市仍要决定对此做什么。

tip: science 作学科通常不可数。

senses.en: to fail to remember

ex.en: Do not forget to write the date.
ex.zh: 别忘了写日期。

ex.en: Towns forget a flood until the same street fills again.
ex.zh: 城镇会忘记洪水，直到同一条街再次积水。

tip: forget to do 是忘了要做；forget doing 是忘了做过。

senses.en: the smallest amount or degree
the smallest in amount

ex.en: This is the least difficult of the three questions.
ex.zh: 这是三道题里最不难的。

ex.en: The least expensive food is not always the one that keeps students awake through the afternoon.
ex.zh: 最便宜的食物不一定能让学生整个下午保持清醒。

tip: at least 表示至少；not in the least 表示一点也不。

senses.en: belonging to a whole country

ex.en: The national museum is free on Wednesdays.
ex.zh: 国家博物馆周三免费。

ex.en: A national exam should not ignore students whose schools lack labs and libraries.
ex.zh: 一场全国性考试不该忽略那些学校缺少实验室和图书馆的学生。

tip: national 是形容词；国家用 nation 或 country。

senses.en: not ordinary

ex.en: Today is a special day for our school.
ex.zh: 今天对我们学校是特别的一天。

ex.en: A special bus for students works only if it arrives before the first lesson, not after.
ex.zh: 学生专车只有在第一节课前到达才有用，而不是课后。

tip: specially 强调专门地；especially 强调尤其。

senses.en: to arrive at, or to touch by stretching
the distance one can stretch

ex.en: We reached the museum before it closed.
ex.zh: 我们在闭馆前到达了博物馆。

ex.en: A warning that does not reach homes without a phone signal arrives too late.
ex.zh: 到不了没有手机信号的家庭的警报，来得太晚。

tip: reach 是及物动词，后面直接接地点，不加 to。

senses.en: to invite someone to compete or try hard
Question whether something is true, fair, or acceptable.
Invite someone to compete or test their abilities.

ex.en: This puzzle will challenge your mind.
ex.zh: 这道谜题会挑战你的思维。

ex.en: Providing affordable housing remains a major challenge for cities experiencing rapid population growth and rising land prices.
ex.zh: 对于人口快速增长、地价不断上涨的城市而言，提供可负担住房仍是一项重大挑战。

col: meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战
challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

senses.en: newspapers, television, and the internet as a group

ex.en: Social media spread the news within an hour.
ex.zh: 社交媒体在一小时内传播了这条消息。

ex.en: The media can help a town prepare for a flood, or they can only arrive to film the damage.
ex.zh: 媒体可以帮助一个城镇为洪水做准备，也可以只在事后前来拍摄损失。

tip: media 是 medium 的复数，谓语常用复数。

senses.en: something said or written clearly

ex.en: The school made a short statement.
ex.zh: 学校发表了一则简短声明。

ex.en: A public statement about a flood should say which roads are closed.
ex.zh: 关于洪水的公开声明应该说明哪些路封闭了。

tip: statement 是可数名词。

senses.en: the threads that grow on the head

ex.en: Tie your hair back in the lab.
ex.zh: 在实验室里把头发扎起来。

ex.en: Hair colour tells you nothing about whether a student can solve the problem.
ex.zh: 头发的颜色说明不了一个学生能否解出这道题。

tip: hair 通常不可数。一根头发用 a hair。

senses.en: of the colour of grass
the colour green

ex.en: The green bike is mine.
ex.zh: 那辆绿色自行车是我的。

ex.en: Green space near a school gives children somewhere to play that is not a car park.
ex.zh: 学校附近的绿地给孩子一个玩耍的地方，而不是停车场。

tip: green 也可表示环保的：green energy。

senses.en: to name, phone, or shout to someone
a phone conversation or a shout

ex.en: We call our teacher Mr. Chen.
ex.zh: 我们称呼老师为陈老师。

ex.en: Parents who call the school only after a problem appears miss the chance to help earlier.
ex.zh: 只在问题出现后才给学校打电话的家长，错过了更早帮忙的机会。

col: give sb a call｜给某人打电话
tip: call sb sth 表示把某人称作……，中间不加 as。

senses.en: measuring a great length or time
to want something very much

ex.en: It was a long walk from the station.
ex.zh: 从车站走过来要很久。

ex.en: A long commute can take away the evening hours that students need for sleep and reading.
ex.zh: 漫长的通勤会占去学生需要用于睡觉和阅读的晚上时间。

tip: how long 询问时间或长度。long 作动词是“渴望”。

senses.en: a movement of the foot, or one stage of a process
to move the foot

ex.en: The first step is to read the question.
ex.zh: 第一步是读题。

ex.en: The next step after a flood warning is a lit path to higher ground, not only a message.
ex.zh: 洪水警报之后的下一步是一条有灯的通往高地的路，而不只是一条信息。

tip: step 作动词是“迈步”。

senses.en: an occasion when people come together

ex.en: The meeting starts at two.
ex.zh: 会议两点开始。

ex.en: A public meeting about a new road should happen before the machines arrive.
ex.zh: 关于新路的公开会议应该在机器到来之前举行。

tip: meeting 是可数名词。

senses.en: twice as much, or made of two parts
to become twice as much

ex.en: We need a double check of the names.
ex.zh: 我们需要把名字再核对一遍。

ex.en: A double fare after dark makes the night bus too costly for the workers who need it most.
ex.zh: 天黑后的双倍票价，让最需要夜班公交的工人负担不起。

tip: double 作动词是“加倍”。

senses.en: a place for money, or the side of a river

ex.en: The bank is next to the post office.
ex.zh: 银行在邮局旁边。

ex.en: Houses on the bank of a river are cheap until the water reaches the door.
ex.zh: 河边的房子在水漫到门口之前显得便宜。

tip: bank 的两个常见义是银行和岸，要看搭配。

senses.en: from one side to the other, or by means of

ex.en: We walked through the market on the way home.
ex.zh: 我们回家时穿过了市场。

ex.en: Students learn more through explaining an idea than through reading the same note again.
ex.zh: 学生通过讲解一个想法学到的，往往多于把同一条笔记再读一遍。

tip: through 强调从内部穿过；across 强调从表面一边到另一边。

senses.en: the state of being safe

ex.en: Road safety is part of the first lesson.
ex.zh: 交通安全是第一课的一部分。

ex.en: Safety on the walk home depends on lights and pavements, not only on advice.
ex.zh: 回家路上的安全取决于灯和人行道，而不只是劝告。

tip: safety 是名词，不可数。

senses.en: a senior member of a government

ex.en: The education minister visited the school.
ex.zh: 教育部长参观了这所学校。

ex.en: A minister who never rides the bus may not see why the last service matters.
ex.zh: 从不坐公交的部长，可能看不到为什么末班车重要。

tip: minister 也可指牧师，考纲里更常见的是政府部长。

senses.en: the activity of using one's mind

ex.en: Critical thinking is part of the history course.
ex.zh: 批判性思考是历史课的一部分。

ex.en: Quick thinking on social media is not the same as careful thinking about a source.
ex.zh: 社交媒体上的快速思考，不等于对来源的仔细思考。

tip: thinking 是 think 的 -ing，也可作名词。

senses.en: an idea for what to do
to decide what to do

ex.en: Our plan is to finish the poster today.
ex.zh: 我们的计划是今天完成海报。

ex.en: A flood plan that exists only on paper will fail the first night the river rises.
ex.zh: 只存在于纸上的防汛计划，会在河水上涨的第一个夜里失败。

tip: plan 作动词后接 to do，不接 doing。

senses.en: a problem
A problem that makes progress or success harder.

ex.en: She overcame great difficulty to succeed.
ex.zh: 她克服巨大困难获得成功。

ex.en: Students with limited internet access may have difficulty completing assignments that require extensive online research.
ex.zh: 网络使用受限的学生可能难以完成需要大量网上研究的作业。

col: have difficulty doing something｜做某事有困难
tip: 用have difficulty doing，不用difficulty to do。

senses.en: not in danger

ex.en: Is the bridge safe after the rain?
ex.zh: 雨后这座桥安全吗？

ex.en: A street is not safe for children if cars park on the only pavement.
ex.zh: 如果汽车停在唯一的人行道上，这条街对孩子就不安全。

tip: safe 是形容词；safety 是名词。

senses.en: causing laughter, or strange

ex.en: The story was funny, and we still learned the word.
ex.zh: 故事很滑稽，我们仍然学会了那个词。

ex.en: It is funny that a town boasts of a new mall while its oldest school still leaks.
ex.zh: 一座城镇吹嘘新商场，而最老的学校仍在漏雨，这很奇怪。

tip: funny 是“滑稽的”或“奇怪的”；fun 是名词“乐趣”。

senses.en: to give money for something
money received for work

ex.en: I paid for the tickets online.
ex.zh: 我在网上付了票钱。

ex.en: Families who pay a large share of their income for rent have less left for books and clinics.
ex.zh: 把收入的很大一部分用来付房租的家庭，留给书和看病的钱就更少。

tip: pay 的过去式和过去分词是 paid。人作主语：sb pays for sth。

senses.en: having lived long, or not new

ex.en: This is an old map, but the river is the same.
ex.zh: 这是一张旧地图，但那条河还是一样的。

ex.en: Old buildings can teach a city what to keep when everything else is being rebuilt.
ex.zh: 当其他一切都在重建时，老建筑可以告诉一座城市该保留什么。

tip: 表示年龄用数字加 years old。兄姐用 elder 或 older 都可以。

senses.en: to greet someone in a friendly way
gladly received
a friendly greeting

ex.en: We welcome new students on the first day.
ex.zh: 我们在第一天欢迎新生。

ex.en: A town should welcome questions about a new road before the machines arrive.
ex.zh: 在机器到来之前，城镇应该欢迎关于新路的提问。

tip: welcome 作形容词是“受欢迎的”：You are welcome。

senses.en: a period of seven days

ex.en: We have a test next week.
ex.zh: 我们下周有一次测验。

ex.en: A four-day school week may cut costs, but it can also lengthen each remaining day beyond what children can manage.
ex.zh: 每周上四天课也许能省钱，但也可能把剩下的每天拉长到孩子承受不了。

tip: next week 前不加 the。

senses.en: a set of connected people, computers, or routes

ex.en: The bus network does not reach our village.
ex.zh: 公交网络到不了我们村。

ex.en: A phone network that fails in a storm leaves the people who need a warning without one.
ex.zh: 在风暴中失灵的电话网络，会让最需要警报的人收不到警报。

tip: network 可指计算机网络，也可指交通或人际网络。

senses.en: to have inside
to prevent something from spreading or becoming stronger

ex.en: This box may contain old letters.
ex.zh: 这个盒子里可能装有旧信。

ex.en: Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.
ex.zh: 加工食品往往含有大量盐分，可能导致严重的健康问题。

tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；表示“含有”时通常不用进行时。

senses.en: before noon

ex.en: The reading room opens at 7 a.m.
ex.zh: 阅览室早上七点开门。

ex.en: Starting lessons at 7 a.m. may suit adults, but many teenagers are still at their sleepiest then.
ex.zh: 早上七点上课也许适合成年人，但许多青少年那时仍处于最困的时候。

tip: a.m. 表示午夜到中午；书写时数字与 a.m. 之间留空格。

senses.en: an informal hello

ex.en: She said hi to the new student.
ex.zh: 她向新同学说了声嗨。

ex.en: A friendly hi at the gate does not replace a safe road, but it can make the first day easier.
ex.zh: 门口一声友好的嗨替代不了安全的路，但能让第一天容易些。

tip: hi 比 hello 更随意，正式场合少用。

senses.en: the red liquid in the body

ex.en: The nurse stopped the blood with a clean cloth.
ex.zh: 护士用干净的布止住了血。

ex.en: Loss of blood is one reason a village clinic must be close, not an hour away.
ex.zh: 失血是乡村诊所必须在近处、而不是一小时之外的原因之一。

tip: blood 不可数。

senses.en: a series of actions
to treat or deal with something in stages

ex.en: Learning a word is a slow process.
ex.zh: 学会一个词是一个缓慢的过程。

ex.en: The process of cleaning a river includes factories upstream, not only the park in the city.
ex.zh: 清理一条河的过程包括上游的工厂，而不只是城里的公园。

col: in the process of｜在……过程中
tip: process 作动词是“加工、处理”，名词重音常在前，动词重音可在后。

senses.en: parents and children, or relatives

ex.en: My family has dinner together on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我们家周日一起吃晚饭。

ex.en: When housing is too expensive, a family may spend so much on rent that little remains for books or clinics.
ex.zh: 当住房太贵时，一个家庭可能把太多钱花在房租上，书籍和看病就所剩无几。

tip: family 作整体时谓语用单数；强调家庭成员时有时用复数。

senses.en: to want to know, or to feel surprise
a feeling of surprise, or something wonderful

ex.en: I wonder whether the museum is open.
ex.zh: 我想知道博物馆是否开着。

ex.en: Residents wonder why a new mall was finished before the leaking school roof.
ex.zh: 居民想知道为什么新商场比漏雨的校舍屋顶先完工。

tip: wonder 后常接 if 或 whether。

senses.en: something added, or the process of adding

ex.en: The new lab is a useful addition to the school.
ex.zh: 新实验室是学校有用的增添。

ex.en: In addition to more roads, the town needs pavements if children are to walk safely.
ex.zh: 除了更多的路，如果孩子要安全走路，城镇还需要人行道。

tip: in addition to 后接名词或 doing。

senses.en: to take to a place; to give a speech
to give a speech, lecture, or presentation
to produce the results or benefits that were promised

ex.en: The post office will deliver the package.
ex.zh: 邮局会递送这个包裹。

ex.en: Public transport projects must deliver clear benefits to local residents if they are to justify substantial investment.
ex.zh: 公共交通项目必须为当地居民带来明确的益处，才能证明大规模投资是合理的。

col: deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。

senses.en: to dislike very strongly
a strong dislike

ex.en: I hate waiting in the rain.
ex.zh: 我讨厌在雨里等。

ex.en: People hate a rule they do not understand more than a rule that is strict but clear.
ex.zh: 人们对不理解的规则的反感，超过对严格但清楚的规则。

tip: hate 后接 doing 或 to do。

senses.en: to rest with the eyes closed
the rest you get at night

ex.en: I sleep for eight hours on school nights.
ex.zh: 上学的晚上我睡八小时。

ex.en: Teenagers sleep better when phones stay out of the bedroom.
ex.zh: 手机不放在卧室时，青少年睡得更好。

tip: sleep 是动词或不可数名词。睡着了用 asleep。

senses.en: a piece of furniture, or a list of figures

ex.en: Please clear the table after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后请把桌子收拾干净。

ex.en: A table of bus times is useless if the last bus leaves before school ends.
ex.zh: 如果末班车在放学前离开，一份公交时刻表就没有用。

tip: table 也可指表格。

senses.en: to tell someone you are grateful

ex.en: I want to thank you for your help.
ex.zh: 我想谢谢你的帮助。

ex.en: Cities should thank the workers who collect rubbish before dawn, not only the people who design the posters.
ex.zh: 城市应该感谢黎明前收垃圾的工人，而不只是设计海报的人。

tip: thank 是动词，后面接人；名词用 thanks。

senses.en: to become a member, or to connect

ex.en: I want to join the choir.
ex.zh: 我想加入合唱团。

ex.en: A new road that does not join the bus network still leaves many people walking.
ex.zh: 不与公交网络相连的新路，仍然让许多人走路。

tip: join 后接团体表示加入；join in 后接活动。

senses.en: most important
a leader

ex.en: The chief reason for the delay was the rain.
ex.zh: 延误的主要原因是下雨。

ex.en: The chief cost of a new road may be the playground it replaces, not the stone it uses.
ex.zh: 一条新路的主要代价，可能是它取代的操场，而不是它用的石头。

tip: chief 作名词是“首领”。

senses.en: hopeful, or certain

ex.en: She gave a positive answer.
ex.zh: 她给了肯定的回答。

ex.en: A positive test result should be explained in words a family can understand.
ex.zh: 阳性的检测结果应该用一个家庭能懂的话来解释。

tip: positive 在检测里表示阳性，在态度里表示积极。

senses.en: a short piece of writing
to notice or write down

ex.en: I wrote a note to remind myself.
ex.zh: 我写了张便条提醒自己。

ex.en: A note in the margin of a shared textbook can help the next reader if the handwriting is clear.
ex.zh: 如果字迹清楚，共用课本页边的笔记能帮助下一个读者。

tip: note 作动词是“注意”或“记下”。

senses.en: to drop down
a drop, or autumn in American English

ex.en: Leaves fall from the tree in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天树叶落下。

ex.en: If wages fall while rents rise, families move farther from the schools they wanted.
ex.zh: 如果工资下降而房租上升，家庭会搬得离他们想去的学校更远。

tip: fall 的过去式是 fell，过去分词是 fallen。秋天是 autumn，美式常用 fall。

senses.en: having a value that makes something sensible

ex.en: The museum is worth a visit.
ex.zh: 这座博物馆值得一看。

ex.en: A long meeting is worth the time if it stops a road being built in the wrong place.
ex.zh: 如果一次长会能避免路修在错误的地方，它就值得花时间。

tip: be worth doing 用主动形式表示被动含义，不说 worth to be done。

senses.en: an electronic machine for storing and using information

ex.en: The computer in the library is free to use.
ex.zh: 图书馆的电脑可以免费使用。

ex.en: A computer in a school helps only when students are also taught how to check a source.
ex.zh: 学校里的电脑只有在同时教会学生核对来源时才有帮助。

tip: computer 是可数名词。

senses.en: a person who trains a team, or a bus for long trips

ex.en: The coach spoke after the match.
ex.zh: 教练在比赛后讲了话。

ex.en: A coach who listens can improve a team more than one who only shouts.
ex.zh: 肯听的教练比只会喊的教练更能提高一支队伍。

tip: coach 也可指长途客车。作动词是“指导”。

senses.en: a rule made by a government, or a scientific rule

ex.en: The new law limits plastic bags in shops.
ex.zh: 新法律限制商店使用塑料袋。

ex.en: A law that nobody can understand is hard to follow, even when its aim is fair.
ex.zh: 一部没人读得懂的法律很难被遵守，即使它的目的是公平的。

tip: law 表示法律时可不可数；一条法律用 a law。

senses.en: the details of where someone lives, or a formal speech
to speak to, or to deal with

ex.en: Write your address on the form.
ex.zh: 把地址写在表格上。

ex.en: An address that a delivery van cannot find is also a problem for an ambulance.
ex.zh: 快递车找不到的地址，对救护车也是问题。

col: address a problem｜处理一个问题
tip: address 作动词是“对……说话”或“处理”。

senses.en: a form of something that is slightly different

ex.en: This is the latest version of the form.
ex.zh: 这是表格的最新版本。

ex.en: An online version of a warning helps only people who can open it.
ex.zh: 警报的网络版本只帮助打得开它的人。

tip: version 是可数名词。

senses.en: a list of money owed, or a proposed law

ex.en: The electricity bill was higher this month.
ex.zh: 这个月的电费账单更高。

ex.en: A bill that limits plastic bags needs shops that will actually follow it.
ex.zh: 限制塑料袋的法案需要真正会执行的商店。

tip: 美式英语里 bill 也可指纸币。

senses.en: as good as possible
to make something as good as it can be

ex.en: Nobody expects a perfect first draft.
ex.zh: 没人指望第一稿就完美。

ex.en: A perfect score on one test does not show whether a student can work with other people.
ex.zh: 一次考试的满分并不能说明学生能否与他人合作。

tip: perfect 作动词是“使完善”，重音常在第二音节。

senses.en: to be the best or to get a prize

ex.en: Our team wants to win the basketball match.
ex.zh: 我们队想赢得篮球赛。

ex.en: A city does not win public trust by announcing a plan it never carries out.
ex.zh: 一座城市不会因为宣布一个从不执行的计划就赢得公众信任。

tip: win 的宾语是比赛、奖品或胜利，不是对手。打败某人用 beat sb。

senses.en: a container with straight sides

ex.en: Put the bottles in the recycling box.
ex.zh: 把瓶子放进回收箱。

ex.en: A box of shared books can keep a village reading when the library bus comes only once a month.
ex.zh: 当图书车每月只来一次时，一箱共用的书能让村子继续有书读。

tip: box 的复数是 boxes。

senses.en: to cause death

ex.en: The late frost can kill young plants.
ex.zh: 晚霜会冻死幼苗。

ex.en: Dirty water can kill fish long before people notice a change in the colour.
ex.zh: 脏水可以在人们注意到颜色变化之前很久就杀死鱼。

tip: kill 是及物动词，后面直接接宾语。

senses.en: enjoyment

ex.en: The game was fun, and we also learned the words.
ex.zh: 游戏很有趣，我们还学了单词。

ex.en: Fun at a festival should not depend on so much plastic that the square is buried in waste the next day.
ex.zh: 节日的乐趣不该依赖那么多塑料，以至于第二天广场被垃圾淹没。

tip: fun 是不可数名词，一般不说 a fun。funny 是“滑稽的”，不等于 fun。

senses.en: the fact of losing something

ex.en: The loss of the old tree changed the street.
ex.zh: 那棵老树的失去改变了这条街。

ex.en: The loss of a night bus is also a loss of safe journeys home.
ex.zh: 夜班公交的取消，也是安全回家路程的损失。

tip: loss 是名词；lose 是动词。

senses.en: coins and notes used to buy things

ex.en: I do not have enough money for two tickets.
ex.zh: 我的钱不够买两张票。

ex.en: Money spent on early reading support can reduce the cost of failure later in secondary school.
ex.zh: 花在早期阅读辅导上的钱，可以减少中学阶段失败带来的后续成本。

tip: money 不可数，不说 moneys 或 a money。

senses.en: something successfully done
The successful completion of a goal through effort.

ex.en: Winning the prize was a great achievement.
ex.zh: 获奖是一项巨大成就。

ex.en: Schools should recognise creative achievements alongside examination results to encourage a wider range of student abilities.
ex.zh: 学校应在重视考试成绩的同时认可创造性成果，以鼓励学生发展多方面的能力。

col: the achievement of goals｜目标的实现
tip: 具体成就可数；表示目标的实现时通常不可数。

senses.en: used for the future or for a suggestion

ex.en: Shall we start the meeting now?
ex.zh: 我们现在开始开会好吗？

ex.en: A town shall not call a road safe until children can cross it without an adult.
ex.zh: 在孩子能不靠成年人过马路之前，城镇不该称一条路是安全的。

tip: Shall I / Shall we 用来提议。陈述将来现在更常用 will。

senses.en: actually existing, or genuine

ex.en: Is this a real diamond or a glass one?
ex.zh: 这是真钻石还是玻璃的？

ex.en: Real progress on air quality is measured in hospital visits, not only in official announcements.
ex.zh: 空气质量的真正进步要用就诊人数来衡量，而不只是官方通报。

tip: real 强调实际存在；true 强调与事实相符。

senses.en: a bank record, or a description of events

ex.en: She opened a bank account for her savings.
ex.zh: 她开了一个银行账户存钱。

ex.en: An honest account of a flood includes the families who lost homes, not only the official numbers.
ex.zh: 对洪水的诚实叙述包括失去家园的家庭，而不只是官方数字。

tip: account for 表示解释原因，或占一定比例。

senses.en: a person who is not named

ex.en: Someone left a notebook on the piano.
ex.zh: 有人把笔记本落在钢琴上了。

ex.en: Someone has to decide which bus routes stay open when a city cannot fund them all.
ex.zh: 当一座城市无法资助所有公交线路时，必须有人决定哪些线路继续开。

tip: someone 后面的形容词要后置：someone important。

senses.en: to receive sound, or to be told

ex.en: I can hear the bell from the playground.
ex.zh: 我在操场上能听见铃声。

ex.en: People hear about a flood on their phones long before they see the water in their own street.
ex.zh: 人们在自己街上看到水之前很久，就从手机上听说了洪水。

tip: hear 是听见的结果；listen 是听的动作。过去式是 heard。

senses.en: used to make a request polite
to make someone happy

ex.en: Please close the window before you leave.
ex.zh: 离开前请把窗户关上。

ex.en: Signs that say please are not enough if the bins are too far from where people finish their food.
ex.zh: 如果垃圾桶离人们吃完东西的地方太远，写着“请”的标牌是不够的。

tip: please 可放在句首或句末。pleased 表示人感到高兴。

senses.en: difficult, solid, or needing effort
with a lot of effort

ex.en: This question is hard, but not impossible.
ex.zh: 这道题难，但不是做不出。

ex.en: Hard plastic that cannot be repaired becomes waste faster than a simple tool made of wood.
ex.zh: 无法修理的硬塑料，会比一件简单的木制工具更快变成垃圾。

tip: hard 可以是“努力地”；hardly 是否定副词“几乎不”，二者完全不同。

senses.en: the direction between south and west

ex.en: The wind came from the south-west.
ex.zh: 风从西南来。

ex.en: Towns in the south-west share one hospital, so the road between them matters in bad weather.
ex.zh: 西南部的城镇共用一家医院，所以它们之间的路在坏天气里很重要。

tip: south-west 也可写作 southwest。

senses.en: what a person knows

ex.en: Local knowledge of the river saved time.
ex.zh: 对这条河的本地知识节省了时间。

ex.en: Knowledge from a textbook and knowledge from a flooded street are both useful.
ex.zh: 来自课本的知识和来自积水街道的知识都有用。

tip: knowledge 不可数，不说 a knowledge，除非说 a knowledge of。

senses.en: arrangement, a command, or a request for goods
to command, or to ask for goods

ex.en: Put the books back in the right order.
ex.zh: 把书按正确顺序放回去。

ex.en: An order to close street markets at dusk can cut noise and also cut the income of small sellers.
ex.zh: 黄昏关闭街头市场的命令能减少噪音，也会减少小贩的收入。

tip: in order to do 表示目的；in order that 后接句子。

senses.en: to experience a feeling or opinion

ex.en: I feel nervous before I speak in class.
ex.zh: 我在课堂上发言前感到紧张。

ex.en: Residents feel the effect of a new airport long before the official noise report is published.
ex.zh: 居民在官方噪音报告公布之前很久，就能感到新机场的影响。

tip: feel 作连系动词，后面接形容词：feel tired，不接 tiredly。

senses.en: to push something firmly
a push, or newspapers and journalists

ex.en: Press the button to open the door.
ex.zh: 按按钮开门。

ex.en: If editors press reporters to publish before they check, false stories spread faster.
ex.zh: 如果编辑催记者在核对之前发表，假消息会传得更快。

tip: the press 表示新闻界。
